comment: Pinned libsodium for the Android jniLibs. crypto/native/build-android-libsodium.sh downloads this exact tarball, refuses it unless the sha256 matches (and the minisign signature, when minisign is installed), and cross-compiles libsodium.so with the NDK. Built with the pinned NDK the output is reproducible and must match so_sha256_with_pinned_ndk. See docs/licensing-audit.md decision 5.
